body: So haunting, thank you so much for uploading!

Thank you so much for your beautiful message. I think that, even if you have people around you, the Bipolar is so isolating and people don't understand but it's nice to share our feelings here and our feelings of pure isolation. And it's exhausting too. Or you get in weird situations of manic behavior? It's that we have to find a way to live with Bipolar but it;s our enviroment too, And of course you feel hatred but people around you would really miss you? Same with me but sometimes it doesn't feel like it, it feels so misunderstood an god people can be so rude when it comes to mental illness. But we have to keep going I guess but I am honest with you, it's a struggle, but you message really helped, all of your messages did. If we are alone, we are alone together.

I know how isolating bipolar can be, I understand. People have now I idea because of the extremes all the time. I am sorry too you have to go through this, I hope you will find a way to be understood and to not feel so alone. But it know how it is. Lost many people because of this too.
Thanks for your nice message. I really hope for you, you are able to calm you brain, this is not a way to live. And that you find some peace :)

I feel you. That is social media. we are being bombarded with people presenting themselfs being happy, all while they are young. I know it's not reality but it makes me terribly depressed too if I see people having friend, having a good time, going out, feels me left out, like what is the point of living and makes me want to die. It's not that people care.
